problem.prevalence.belief_sentence: Most of these commuters who cycle had this at least once in the last 7 nights.

problem.frequency.belief_sentence: Commuters who cycle face this on 2 to 4 nights out of 7.

problem.severity.belief_sentence: For commuters who cycle, one episode throws the morning off.

problem.duration.belief_sentence: A typical episode takes 5 to 15 minutes from start to finish.

problem.importance.belief_sentence: Among the difficulties that come with the morning they cannot find their keys, this is one of the top three.

problem.consequence.belief_sentence: After an episode, commuters who cycle are left with lateness and stress.

problem.workaround_burden.belief_sentence: In the moment, commuters who cycle try retracing their steps, the spare set, in that order.

problem.current_solution_satisfaction.belief_sentence: The way commuters who cycle handle it today is hit and miss.

solution.compatibility.belief_sentence: It fits into the episode once the first look has failed.

solution.relative_advantage.belief_sentence: To be worth switching to, it must mainly deliver a shorter search.

solution.effectiveness_threshold.belief_sentence: It is worth using only if it saves at least 5 minutes per episode.

solution.trust_risk.belief_sentence: Commuters who cycle would act on it only if it is loud enough.

solution.reliability_tolerance.belief_sentence: They keep using it as long as it is wrong no more than about one time in ten.

solution.adoption_friction.belief_sentence: The most extra effort they would accept at the moment of use is a single whistle.

solution.trialability.belief_sentence: They would try it for the first time if it is free to try.

solution.observability.belief_sentence: They would know it helped when they found the keys sooner.

solution.target_circumstance.belief_sentence: It matters most when they are already running late.

commercial.existing_sacrifice.belief_sentence: Because of this, commuters who cycle already give up money on spare keys.

commercial.wtp_hypothesis.belief_sentence: A fair price would feel like £2 to £4 per month (a hypothesis; interviews do not test it).

commercial.ability_to_pay.belief_sentence: They could find the money for it without a second thought.

commercial.buyer_payer_alignment.belief_sentence: On buying: the same person uses it, decides and pays.

commercial.purchase_friction.belief_sentence: Between wanting it and paying, forgetting by evening could hold them back.

commercial.commitment.belief_sentence: For a trial, right now, they would go as far as installing the app.
